# Liu Peng

Staff Software Engineer at Mapbox, building the Maps SDK for Android used by millions of developers worldwide. 13+ years of experience in mobile development, embedded systems, and full-stack applications.

Contact: {{ site.social-network-links.email }} | GitHub: https://github.com/{{ site.social-network-links.github }} | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/{{ site.social-network-links.linkedin }}/

## About

Staff software engineer with over 13 years of experience in mobile development, embedded systems, and full-stack applications. Drives technical direction and architecture decisions across teams, with expertise in Android development, SDK development, multimedia streaming, and mapping technologies.

Worked on diverse projects from consumer mobile apps to enterprise IoT solutions, with a strong focus on quality, performance, clean maintainable code, and exceptional user experiences. Contributes to open source projects and shares knowledge with the developer community.
